scripts.test:import: npm exec --workspace @activus/api -- vitest run test/legacy-import.test.ts test/legacy-activity-mapping.test.ts
scripts.dev: npm run build --workspace @activus/contracts && concurrently --raw --kill-others --names contracts,api,web "npm run dev --workspace @activus/contracts" "npm run dev --workspace @activus/api" "npm run dev --workspace @activus/web"
scripts.build: npm run build --workspace @activus/contracts && npm run build --workspace @activus/api && npm run build --workspace @activus/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run build --workspace @activus/contracts && npm run typecheck --workspaces
scripts.test: npm run build --workspace @activus/contracts && npm run test --workspaces --if-present
scripts.db:generate: npm run build --workspace @activus/contracts && npm run db:generate --workspace @activus/api --
scripts.db:migrate: npm run build --workspace @activus/contracts && npm run db:migrate --workspace @activus/api --
scripts.test:db: npm run build --workspace @activus/contracts && npm run test:db --workspace @activus/api --
scripts.test:browser: npm run build --workspace @activus/contracts && npm run build --workspace @activus/web && npm run test:browser --workspace @activus/web --
scripts.test:browser:edge: npm run build --workspace @activus/contracts && npm run build --workspace @activus/web && npm exec --workspace @activus/web -- playwright test --config playwright.edge.config.ts
